issues.suggested_action: Replace the initial face insert with a screen beat, or select an initial reaction take that matches the facial proportions of the later Maya shots.

issues.suggested_action: Show the original slide and downloaded slide consecutively at larger scale, holding each for 2.5 seconds and emphasizing only the missing chart and wrong template.

issues.suggested_action: Keep the introduction headline and shorten the subtitle to 'Every change, reviewable. Accept or reject each one.'

issues.evidence: The edit timeline inserts separate music excerpts beneath the new review and David shots, then resumes the original composition. Supplied still frames cannot establish whether these joins sound continuous or whether generated facial motion remains stable.
